name: @appstrate/gitlab-mcp
description: GitLab integration backed by GitLab's own MCP server ({instance}/api/v4/mcp), for GitLab.com and for any self-managed or Dedicated instance: the instance URL is a connection variable, so one package serves every instance and each connection reaches only its own. The sidecar opens a Streamable HTTP MCP client and injects the actor's OAuth2 access token as `Authorization: Bearer …`. Authorization is chosen per connection, against the instance the user named: RFC 9728 protected-resource discovery on the rendered MCP URL, whose advertised authorization server must be the instance URL itself (`issuer: {$variable.base_url}`, so an instance served under a path prefix works too), RFC 8414 metadata, RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration as a public client (`token_endpoint_auth_method: none`) and RFC 7636 PKCE (S256), one client per instance and space. No OAuth application is created by hand — and none can be: an instance whose administrator turned dynamic client registration off cannot be connected. The single `mcp` scope covers every tool; GitLab issues a refresh token with every authorization code. MCP access must be allowed for the top-level group on GitLab.com, or for the instance on self-managed. The server returns its default toolsets (core, merge_requests, work_items, repository, ci, duo_agent_platform); the opt-in wikis and code_security toolsets are not requested. The tool set grows with each GitLab release and differs between instances, so the catalogue below is GitLab 19.5's and `allow_undeclared_tools` lets an agent take whatever its instance advertises.

base_url.title: URL de l'instance GitLab
base_url.description: Adresse de votre instance, sans /api/v4 (ex. https://gitlab.example.com, ou https://example.com/gitlab si elle est servie sous un chemin) ; gardez https://gitlab.com pour GitLab.com. L'accès au serveur MCP doit y être autorisé : par le groupe de premier niveau sur GitLab.com, par un administrateur sur une instance auto-hébergée, qui doit aussi laisser activé l'enregistrement dynamique des clients OAuth.

scope_catalog.label: GitLab MCP server
scope_catalog.description: Access to the GitLab MCP server with the user's own GitLab permissions. GitLab's only MCP scope: every tool runs under it.
